 CLAT Cut-Off 2027: Check Expected and Previous Year Rank Analysis
 By Jaya Gupta Last Updated: Nov 19, 2026, 23:35 IST Candidates preparing for CLAT 2027 can check expected cut-off ranks for top NLUs based on previous year trends provided below. The article includes detailed analysis of closing ranks from 2022-2025 and marks vs. rank predictions to aid NLU preference selection.
 CLAT Cut-Off 2027: Check Expected and Previous Year Rank Analysis 
 CLAT Cut-Off 2027:  CLAT Aspirants appearing for CLAT 2027 on 6th December 2026 can check previous year trends along withe expected cutoff provided here. This will help them create a realistic preferences for NLUs based on previous cut-off ranks as well as possible rank predictions. However, the provided cutoffs are estimated and actual cut-offs may vary every year depending upon various factors including the level of the question paper, the number of applicants, seat matrices, quota systems, and domicile criteria, historical records prove to be a much better predictor. It is advisable for aspirants to take note of the dynamics of current ranks in leading NLUs, good NLUs, and new law schools.

 CLAT 2027 Expected Cutoff Ranks  
 The expected CLAT 2027 cutoff ranks of the five institutes such as NLSIU Bengaluru, NALSAR Hyderabad, WBNUJS Kolkata, NLU Jodhpur, and GNLU Gandhinagar has been provided below. The previous year shows an increasing trend in terms of rank numbers from the highest ranked institute to the fifth one with variations within General, OBC, EWS, SC, and ST categories.  
 NLSIU Bengaluru is located at the tightest end, which includes Rank 100 (General), Rank 110 (EWS), Rank 130 (OBC), Rank 300 (SC), and Rank 500 (ST), whereas NALSAR Hyderabad follows at Rank 150 (General), Rank 170 (EWS), Rank 200 (OBC), Rank 400 (SC), and Rank 600 (ST).  CLAT 2027 Marks vs. Rank Analysis 
 For CLAT 2027 mark vs rank, out of a total of 120, candidates can observe the All India Rank (AIR) range. The chances of getting admitted in the General category change according to score ranges from AIR 1-50 for 105+ to AIR 700-2,500 for the 75-84.75 range.  
 The score ranges of 105+ (AIR 1-50) are associated with an excellent standing among the top three NLUs, the 100-104.75 (AIR 1-150). The score range suggests that one has strong chances of getting into top NLUs such as NLSIU and NALSAR, while 95-99.75 (AIR 50-350) is highly competitive for multiple top NLUs.
